title: openai /v1/chat.completions parity: params, roles, stop/logprobs, response-formatting, streaming stability
description: Motivation: Bring Redwood's OpenAI-compat /v1/chat.completions surface to parity for REST and streaming paths. This PR consolidates parameter handling (max_tokens, temperature, top_p, presence/ frequency penalties), role handling for assistant/system/user messages, stop token passthrough and logprobs plumbing, and response formatting edge-cases observed in our compatibility tests. It also contains targeted fixes to streaming stability when combined with function/tool calling and structured output framing. Summary of changes: parameter normalization layer added to translate OpenAI-style params to internal model config; role-preservation logic to ensure original roles are present in context and preserved in streaming chunks; stop token handling moved earlier in pipeline to avoid extra tokens on near-boundary flushes; logprobs support exposed behind compat flag and disabled by default for large sequences; response formatting fixes for truncated JSON and tool-calls when using streaming with structured output. Includes compatibility test-suite updates, SDK compatibility shim adjustments in python/ts SDKs, and docs notes. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for param translation and role mapping - [x] Integration tests for stop token handling in non-streaming and streaming - [x] E2E test for function/tool calling with streaming structured output - [x] Docs update and release notes drafted - [x] CI green on final run
author: Ethan Park
release_notes: - OpenAI /v1/chat.completions parity improvements: params, roles, stop/logprobs, response formatting; - Streaming stability improvements for tool/function-calls with structured output; - Opt-in logprobs behind compat flag; - SDK minor shims to preserve parity
commits: a1b2c3: add param-normalizer and translation layer; d4e5f6: preserve roles through streaming; 7g8h9i: stop-token early-eval and tests; j0k1l2: logprobs plumbing behind feature flag; m3n4o5: SDK shim + docs
review_comments: Maya Chen requested changes to the param mapping for temperature/top_p to avoid double-scaling; author updated mapping and added tests.
Sara Liu asked for an explicit opt-in flag for logprobs because of potential memory blowups; implemented feature flag 'compat.logprobs_enabled' and added warning logs.
Diego Morales reported a streaming edge where JSON framing for structured tool output could be split across chunks; replaced naive writer with framed-chunk serializer and added e2e test.
CI initially failed on linting and a flaky e2e that expected role tokens to be normalized; fixed linter issues and made role-preservation deterministic in streamer.
notes_on_deployment: Deploy rollout: canary 5% traffic on Dedicated and Hosted for 24h, monitor chat_parity_error_rate and streaming_chunk_error_rate; enable compat.logprobs_enabled only per-customer on request; SDKs pinned to backward-compatible shims for one minor release.
testing_notes: Run e2e/chat_parity with --streaming and --functions flags; use large-context fixtures to validate stop token behavior near chunk boundaries; run perf lab for latency regression under batching enabled.
